why: Stage A of design 2, probes only: the resting cell. Wall gain 3, bias -3, fast. K is tonic (bias +8) and tilts the wall forward (out 1.5 cos theta), so at rest the cell creeps ahead at about 1.6 R/tick, the motion its comparison will read. S1-S3 adapt slowly (tau 100, so the loop stays stable while staying steep: spokes in 8 - 8 cos theta, bias -8), pressing the wall down (-8 each) as the light grows. F (tau 3) and SL (tau 30) read the same front-blind sum with the same bias, to show where they sit across light levels.
